summary: Thiscall boolean check over a dynamically indexed child object. Reads the index at field 0x1C of this (this[7]), loads the child object pointer at this[this[7]+8], returns 0 when that pointer is null, otherwise dispatches a virtual call (thiscall on the child, method pointer read at child+28) and returns 0 when that call's result equals 2, else returns 1. Called from RendererSceneNodeUpdate (0x004C97B0). The prelabel's 'returns field 0x1C' description does not match the raw source and is not used.

local_names.v2: flag whether virtual call result equals 2

operations.description: Read the index field at this+0x1C (this[7]); when the child object at this[this[7]+8] is null, return 0.
Invoke the virtual thiscall method whose pointer is stored at offset 28 of the child object's vtable (*(*child + 28)), passing child as the this pointer; compare its result against 2.
Return 0 when the virtual call result equals 2; otherwise return 1.

unresolved: Semantics of the virtual method result: value 2 selects the false/0 path, but the meaning of the enumeration (state 2) is unknown.
Identity of the child object's class and of the virtual method at vtable offset 28.
Which this-object layout is indexed by this[7]; the index selects the child at this[this[7]+8], but the container semantics are unproven.
